title: 54th All India Science Teachers' Conference & National Science Seminar
summary: Updated official invitation for the 54th All India Science Teachers’ Conference and National Science Seminar, jointly announced by The Association of Science Teachers and All India Science Teachers’ Association (AISTA), on 12–13 December 2026 at V. V. Giri University, Chintamanpur, Daraundha, Siwan, Bihar – 841404. Focal theme: Emerging Trends in Artificial Intelligence (A.I.). Open or download the updated invitation for venue, accommodation, delegate fees, schedule, travel and contact details.

title: Upcoming Conference at V. V. Giri University
summary: The next conference of The Association of Science Teachers will be held on 12 and 13 December 2026 at V. V. Giri University, Daraundha, Siwan, Bihar. Further programme and participation details will be announced by the Association.
